turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I have no doubt that I am looking at a man who is accustomed to giving orders, not taking them. Now, let us proceed with the case at hand. What is the nature of this scandal, and how do I come into it?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, I am intrigued by the gravity of the situation you have brought to our attention. Might I inquire as to the particulars of this scandal and how it affects your royal personage?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am beset on all sides by intrigue and deception. My reputation, nay, my very life hangs in the balance, and I fear that I am losing control of the situation.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must warn you, Your Majesty, that I am not a miracle worker. I can only investigate the facts and provide guidance based on my observations. Tell me, what is the nature of this 'scandal' that has you so distressed?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must say that I am deeply concerned for your well-being and the implications of this scandal. Might I suggest that we proceed with caution and gather all the facts before we attempt to unravel the tangled threads of this affair?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that I have not been entirely forthcoming, gentlemen. The scandal, as I have come to understand it, involves my...ahem...my daughter's reputation.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that a princess's reputation is a fragile thing indeed. Pray tell, what evidence do you have that suggests her reputation is at risk?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must confess that I find the mention of your daughter's reputation to be a most distressing development. Might I inquire as to the nature of her involvement in this scandal, and what actions she has taken to address the situation?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Alas, gentlemen, I fear I have put myself in a precarious position by involving you in this matter. I must confess that my daughter's reputation is not the only thing at risk, for there are those who would seek to use this information to their advantage, and perhaps even to my own detriment.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must say that your daughter's reputation is but a symptom of a larger problem. I perceive that there is a more significant issue at play here, one that threatens not only your family's honor but also the balance of power in Europe.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must press you for more information. Can you tell me who these individuals are who seek to use this information to their advantage?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand the gravity of the situation. I have reason to believe that my daughter's photograph has been stolen, and in the wrong hands, it could lead to catastrophic consequences for my family and my country.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist that you reveal to me the full extent of your family's entanglement with this woman, Irene Adler. Her name has come up in my investigation, and I suspect she may be more than just an innocent party in this affair.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Pray, Your Majesty, tell me more about this woman, Irene Adler. What is her relationship to your daughter, and how does she fit into this complicated web of intrigue?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear I may have already said too much, gentlemen. I implore you, for the sake of my family and my kingdom, do not pry into the personal affairs of my daughter. My loyalty is to my country, and I must be careful not to reveal more than I am able to reveal.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must warn you, Your Majesty, that I have already seen the photograph in question, and I fear it is too late to conceal its existence. I will not pry into the personal affairs of your daughter, but I must uncover the truth behind the theft of this photograph.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must agree with my friend Sherlock that the photograph's existence cannot be hidden indefinitely. Might I ask, Your Majesty, if there is any particular reason why this photograph is so crucial to your family's well-being?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that the photograph in question is a likeness of my daughter, and its theft has placed her in grave danger. I beg of you, do not let its existence fall into the wrong hands, for it could unleash a catastrophe upon my kingdom and my family.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must consider the consequences of this photograph's existence, and I must know more about the woman who is at the center of this intrigue, Irene Adler. Tell me, Your Majesty, what is the nature of your relationship with her?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, I am intrigued by the mention of Irene Adler. Who is this woman, and what is her connection to your daughter, Your Majesty?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
